blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is "The End of the Month". It gives you short, useful sentences for the finance team.

You will learn five simple words: month, week, Friday, morning and midnight. You will also practise the prepositions of time: in, on and at. We say "in the morning", "on Friday" and "at midnight".

Go slowly. One step at a time. Sophie helps new trainees, so you are not alone. You can do it!

items.q: What is today's lesson about?
items.why: "Today's lesson is 'The End of the Month'."

items.q: How many new words will you learn?
items.why: "You will learn five simple words."

items.q: Which prepositions of time does the lesson practise?
items.why: "the prepositions of time: in, on and at."

items.q: "Sophie helps new trainees, so you are not alone." This suggests that…
items.why: Inferência: se a Sophie ajuda, o trainee terá apoio.

items.q: What is the tone of the text?
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly", "You can do it!" mostram um tom gentil e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com o novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, and welcome to the team. My name is Sophie. I work in accounting here at Czarnikow.

Today I want to help you with time words. They are very easy. Listen and repeat with me.

We use "in" for the morning. So we say, "I check the numbers in the morning." We use "on" for days. So we say, "We close the books on Friday." And we use "at" for midnight. So we say, "The report is ready at midnight."

Every month we do the same work. Every week we look at the numbers again. It is a small team, but we are very careful. One step at a time.

Do not worry if it is slow at first. That is normal. Take your time, ask me your questions, and repeat the words with me. You can do it. I am happy to help you this week and next week too.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "I work in accounting here at Czarnikow."

items.q: Which preposition does Sophie use for days like Friday?
items.why: "We use 'on' for days… 'We close the books on Friday.'"

items.q: When is the report ready?
items.why: "The report is ready at midnight."

items.q: Sophie says "Do not worry if it is slow at first." This suggests that…
options: learning takes a little time, and that is okay
the work is too hard for anyone
items.why: Inferência: ela tranquiliza o trainee — ir devagar no começo é normal.

items.q: How would you describe Sophie?
items.why: Inferência: ela repete, encoraja e se oferece para ajudar — é paciente e prestativa.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We close the books at the end of the month." A month is…
options: one of the twelve parts of a year
items.why: Month = mês, uma das doze partes do ano.

items.q: "There is a lot of work this week." A week has…
items.why: Week = semana, sete dias.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We close the books on ___, the last day of the work week."
items.why: Friday = sexta-feira, o último dia da semana de trabalho.

items.q: "I drink my coffee in the morning." The morning is…
options: the early part of the day
items.why: Morning = manhã, a parte inicial do dia.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The report is ready at ___, when the clock shows 12:00 at night."
items.why: Midnight = meia-noite, 12:00 da noite.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia do trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please hand in the report on Friday." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar (algo a alguém).

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the numbers." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We close the books at the end of the month." This means we…
items.why: Close the books = fechar as contas do período.

items.q: "Let's go over the numbers again." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, checar com cuidado.

items.q: "Sophie said she will help out this week." To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, colaborar.
